metadata.title: DeAndre Carter catches pass in Week 9
metadata.description: DeAndre Carter caught his only target for five yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
metadata.analysis: Carter has been an afterthought in the Detroit offense, seeing his first target of the season in Sunday's win. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter - Signs with active roster
metadata.description: The Lions signed Carter to the active roster Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Carter last played for Cleveland in 2025, and he served as the team's main return man. The 33-year-old veteran is expected to do the same for Detroit after the season-ending knee injury to Tom Kennedy, per Eric Woodyard of ESPN.com.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter - Signs with Detroit's practice squad
metadata.description: The Lions signed Carter to the practice squad Monday.
metadata.analysis: Carter played four games with the Browns in 2025 before succumbing to a knee injury but did not log any offensive snaps in the contests. The wide receiver played 31 special-teams snaps over the healthy span and will likely fill a similar role for the Lions if he is ever elevated to the active roster.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter signs with Lions
metadata.description: DeAndre Carter has signed to join the Lions' practice squad.
metadata.analysis: Carter has yet to play this season after he was released by the Browns in late August. The veteran appeared in four games for the Browns last season, returning six punts and 11 kickoffs while playing solely on special teams.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter - Tryout in Houston
metadata.description: Carter worked out with the Texans on Thursday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
metadata.analysis: Carter ended the 2025 season in late September with a serious knee issue. The wide receiver was the Browns' top kick and punt returner before the issue and is finally ready to reclaim a spot on an NFL roster. With the Texans' lead returner Jaylin Noel (finger) on the active/non-football injury list, Carter may have a chance to prove himself to the team.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter - Lands on IR
metadata.description: The Browns placed Carter (knee) on injured reserve Monday, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
metadata.analysis: Carter -- who has been Cleveland's top returner on kickoffs and punts -- sustained a knee injury during the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday. He will now be forced to miss at least the next four games and will be first eligible to be reinstated from IR ahead of the Browns' Week 10 clash against the Jets on Sunday, Nov. 9. Jerome Ford, Kaden Davis and undrafted rookie Isaiah Bond are the top candidates to assume return duties in Carter's absence.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter - Sidelined for weeks
metadata.description: Head coach Kevin Stefanski told reporters Monday that Carter (knee) will miss "weeks," Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Cleveland's top kick and punt returner sustained a knee injury in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday and will now be sidelined for the coming weeks. Carter had already tallied 274 kick-return and 56 punt-return yards over just four games, so this could be a huge loss to the Browns' special-teams unit. Jerome Ford will likely be the primary kickoff returner in Carter's absence, while wideouts Isaiah Bond and Kaden Davis, currently on the practice squad, could also see increased duties on special teams.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter ruled out for Week 5
metadata.description: Browns coach Kevin Stefanski said DeAndre Carter came out of Sunday's game with a multi-week injury and will be sidelined for Week 5.
metadata.analysis: Stefanski said Carter came out of this past week's game with multi-week injuries. He is considered week-to-week.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter - Dealing with knee injury
metadata.description: Head coach Kevin Stefanski relayed that Carter suffered a knee injury during the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Carter will undergo further tests to determine the severity of the injury, and his practice participation will provide clarity on his status heading into the Browns' Week 5 clash against the Vikings on Sunday, Oct. 5 in London. Carter turned five kickoff returns into 129 yards in Sunday's loss, and his absence would open the door for undrafted rookie Isaiah Bond to take over return duties.

metadata.title: DeAndre Carter - Resumes return role
metadata.description: Carter returned two punts for 15 yards and one kickoff for 27 yards in Sunday's 13-10 win over the Packers.
metadata.analysis: Carter was removed from last week's game due to a concussion and missed the first two practices during the preparation for Week 3. He's returned six kickoffs for 145 yards and five punts for 56 yards through three weeks.
